about.title: About
body: Think Orbit helps ordinary people understand emerging technology, future skills and new business ideas.
We link to original sources and never copy full articles.
Some text is written from fixed templates. We say so where it applies.

contact.title: Contact
body: For questions, corrections or takedown requests, email the address set in config/site.json (contact_email).
TODO(owner): put a real email before launch.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: No login. No tracking scripts. No cookies set by us.
Saved items are stored only in your browser (localStorage) and never sent to us.
GitHub Pages may log visits under GitHub's own policy.
TODO(legal review): confirm wording for your jurisdiction (e.g. India DPDP Act).

terms.title: Terms of Use
body: Content is for information and learning only. It is not financial, legal or career advice.
Skills and courses do not guarantee jobs.
Third-party links are not under our control.
TODO(legal review).

copyright.title: Copyright and Takedown
body: We respect rights holders. If you believe content here infringes your rights, email the contact address with the page link and proof of ownership.
We aim to review requests promptly and remove content where appropriate.
TODO(legal review): add designated agent details if needed.

corrections.title: Editorial and Corrections
body: We separate source facts from editorial context.
Speculation is labelled as uncertain.
To report an error, use the Contact page. Corrections are noted on the page.

sources.title: Sources and Attribution
body: Only sources approved in our public rights registry (config/sources.json) are published automatically.
Each story shows its publisher and links to the original.
Currently approved: Hacker News API (links and titles) and arXiv (metadata, CC0).
